description: This PHP class 'ImportFieldSanitize' handles sanitization and validation of imported data fields such as dates, emails, times, and related fields within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. The class includes methods for checking format conformity and ensuring data validity, designed to be used during the import process to sanitize user input and maintain data integrity.

classes.name: ImportFieldSanitize
classes.description: A class used for sanitizing various import fields such as dates, emails, and times, providing methods to validate and convert field values to ensure compatibility and correctness during data import.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Dynamically calls sanitization methods for specific field types like 'relate'.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Validates and formats date values according to locale and format settings.

methods.name: email
methods.description: Validates email addresses against a regex pattern.

methods.name: synctooutlook
methods.description: Validates synchronization fields for Outlook, ensuring referenced users or teams exist.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Validates and converts time fields according to timezone and format.

methods.name: isValidTimeDate
methods.description: Checks whether a date/time string matches the expected format and valid ranges.
